text:
marta: Heads-up — planned maintenance for eu-west-3 (NIC fw + kernel) night of Tue. Target window 01:00–03:00 UTC. We'll perform rolling node drains in 15m cohorts across gpu-pool-128 and gpu-pool-256. Expect transient 10–20% capacity reduction and possible KV cache cold starts. Reply if this hits your workload.

alex: ACK. Any expected CI/job collisions? I have nightly evals at 01:10-01:40.

marta: Good catch — we can shift start to 02:00–04:00 to avoid that if ops + infra OK. Decision in thread.

jamie: Please ensure we run kv-cache seeding after each cohort backfill, otherwise latency spikes for small chat workloads. Suggest prewarm job: `kubectl apply -f jobs/kv-seed.yml --namespace=infra-tests` and seed prefixes.

sara: 02:00 would be better for us (large batch exports at 01:20). 02:00 start + 15m cohorts sound fine.

kevin: I'm fine with 02:00. Add `rolling-drain-threshold: 70` in orchestration so we don't over-evict. Also we'll open a temporary burst fallback to us-west with lower tier models to absorb spike.

marta: Plan updated: window 02:00–04:00 UTC, cohorts 15m, max concurrency 1/4 of pool. Fallback routing enabled to us-west with policy `latency-hedge`.

marta: Playbook snippet (quick):
```
# drain cohort nodes
for n in $(cat cohort-nodes.txt); do
  kubectl cordon $n
  kubectl drain $n --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --timeout=10m
  # wait for backfill and kv seed
  ./scripts/seed-kv.sh $n || echo "kv-seed-failed $n"
  kubectl uncordon $n
done
```

alex: Two operational asks: 1) mark tenants with `priority=high` to avoid eviction; 2) telemetry flag to keep token-level costs attributed (we need cost impact sketch).

marta: Noted. We'll annotate `tenant-protection=true` for top-10 paying tenants. Cost ballpark: +$3k-$6k for extended backfill / burst egress if we hit fallback. Will update PRD.

deploy-bot: Maintenance ticket created #MAINT-4821 (eu-west-3), scheduled 7098765432 -> 7098765600

oncall-bot: Incident channels will be auto-opened if >3% pod error rate or >200ms p95 latency for >10m.

sara: Thanks — will shift exports and block major batch jobs overnight.

jamie: I'll own kv-seed script and watch telemetry during run. Ping me in thread during execution.

marta: Awesome. Final plan: start 02:00 UTC, cohorts 15m, fallback enabled, tenant protection for top-10, kv-seed post-drain. If no objections by EOD I'll hit the schedule.

alex: no objections :thumbsup:

kevin: :+1:
